meta.note: Per-cell population by 9 age bands x 2 sexes, from WorldPop 2020 1km unconstrained per-country GeoTIFFs, reduced onto data/rate-grid.json's own 0.5deg lattice. Corrects 04-04's WorldPop-infeasibility verdict, which tested only the global 118 GB mosaic -- see this module's docstring. Feeds tier 2's population x national-age-specific-rate estimator in scripts/build-age-sex-cells.ts; tier 3 (the old CDR-gap proxy, or the flat national pyramid) still answers everywhere WorldPop was not fetched for.
meta.apportionment80PlusNote: WorldPop's open-ended 80+ group straddles bands[7]=[75,84] and bands[8]=[85,200]; split per country x sex using data/mortality-age-sex.json's own 75-84-vs-85+ DEATH share as a stand-in for the population split -- an apportionment, not an observation. See each covered country's apportionment80Plus in data/source/worldpop/reduced/{ISO3}.json.
